content.title: Exclusive-AI software startup Harness valued at $5.5 billion in latest financing round
content.summary: Harness, an AI software development startup, has raised $200 million in a Goldman Sachs-led fundraising round that values ​it at $5.5 billion, the company said on Thursday.  Private market investors continue to plough into artificial intelligence as the nascent technology promises to universally automate structured and repetitive corporate and tech tasks.  Harness is also planning a $40 million tender offer with participation ⁠from existing investors IVP, ‌Menlo Ventures and Unusual Ventures.

content.title: Israeli AI startup Wonderful raises another $100 million, valued at $700 million
content.summary: JERUSALEM (Reuters) -Israeli startup Wonderful, whose platform allows companies to  ​manage AI agents serving customers across voice, chat, ‌and email in any language, on Tuesday said it had raised another ‌$100 million in a private funding round.  Wonderful said it was experiencing rapid growth and ‌had expanded into new markets in Europe and the Middle East since July was preparing to launch in Asia-Pacific in early 2026.  The latest funding round was led by Index ‍Ventures, with ⁠participation from Insight Partners and IVP, along with existing investors Bessemer and Vine Ventures.
